name: Yabane
description: Arrow feathers stacked in columns, dark and light by turns like a checker, each chevron split down the shaft in two shades and the columns pointing up and down.

code.style: --rule: ( @x(even) { -webkit-transform: scaleY(-1); transform: scaleY(-1); } @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 100%; height: 136%; background: @match((x + y) % 2 == 0, @p(var(--color1), var(--color2)), @p(var(--color3), var(--color4))); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0% 26.47%, 50% 0%, 50% 73.53%, 0% 100%); clip-path: polygon(0% 26.47%, 50% 0%, 50% 73.53%, 0% 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 100%; height: 136%; background: @match((x + y) % 2 == 0, @p(var(--color2), var(--color1)), @p(var(--color4), var(--color3))); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 100% 26.47%, 100% 100%, 50% 73.53%); clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 100% 26.47%, 100% 100%, 50% 73.53%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
